macro.waffle_shop.line_total_cents.name: line_total_cents
macro.waffle_shop.line_total_cents.macro_sql:
"""Currency formatting macros."""


def line_total_cents(price_cents: str, quantity: str) -> str:
    """Calculate line total cents from a unit price and quantity."""
    return f"{price_cents} * {quantity}"

macro.waffle_shop.timestamp_trunc.name: timestamp_trunc
macro.waffle_shop.timestamp_trunc.macro_sql:
"""Time expression macros."""

from sqlbuild.compiler.compile.models import MacroContext


def timestamp_trunc(ctx: MacroContext, grain: str, expression: str) -> str:
    """Render timestamp truncation for the active adapter."""

    if ctx.adapter_name == "bigquery":
        return f"TIMESTAMP_TRUNC({expression}, {grain.upper()})"
    return f"DATE_TRUNC('{grain}', {expression})"
